'''''Qork''''' was a [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] belonging to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Along with the [[Mist (escort carrier)|''Mist'']], it delivered supplies to the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Garrett (Star Destroyer)|''Garrett'']].
